p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-ballys-qa_sep-12-2025.pdf
p1.excerpt: Our bus service commitments are centered around maintaining and enhancing the existing Bally’s shuttle service, which currently operates at 10 locations throughout our local catchment area and provides free, accessible transportation to thousands of community members and their families. This shuttle service is a critical component of our commitment to providing convenient and reliable transportation options for our patrons and employees. We plan to expand this based on usage and demand.

p2.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-ballys-qa_sep-12-2025.pdf
p2.excerpt: Our goal is to include additional stops (1) within Ferry Point Park and (2) within our site or at its entrance, which would enhance transit access for our employees and visitors.

p3.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-ballys-qa_sep-12-2025.pdf
p3.excerpt: Based on ongoing dialogue with the MTA including during the CEQR process, we have agreed that Bally’s would be responsible for funding the construction of bus stops and any associated infrastructure required to meet MTA standards.

p4.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-bronx-supplement-executive-summary-clean
p4.excerpt: We are allocating $100 million for parkland improvements, including new walking paths, playgrounds, and the revitalization of Ferry Point Park, as well as at least $75 million for transportation upgrades such as a new Lafayette Avenue overpass, widened roads, and enhanced public transit access to the Project Site and Ferry Point Park via two new MTA bus stops.

p5.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-bronx-cac-questions-with-responses-9.3.2025_vf.pdf
p5.excerpt: the proposed integrated facility would provide space for an MTA bus stop on-site, as well as a bus stop along the proposed reconstructed Ring Road in Ferry Point Park for Park users.

p6.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-bronx-cac-questions-with-responses-9.3.2025_vf.pdf
p6.excerpt: Preliminary discussions have been held with MTA regarding potential extension of bus lines to the Project Site and with NYCEDC regarding potential for increased ferry service to the Ferry Point Park ferry landing.

p7.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-bronx-cac-questions-with-responses-9.3.2025_vf.pdf
p7.excerpt: Commitments for increased service for the MTA bus stops are in place, but specific details will need to be further materialized.

p8.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-bronx-supplement-executive-summary-clean
p8.excerpt: In collaboration with elected officials, community organizations, and local stakeholders, Bally’s has pledged approximately $765 million in net present value for an array of community benefits—in addition to the direct project scope and equity investment opportunities. This unprecedented commitment includes direct financial support for local schools, housing, mental health, public safety, transportation upgrades, parkland enhancements and community organizations.

p9.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/ballys-bronx-supplement-executive-summary-clean
p9.excerpt: Bally’s Bronx is also investing heavily in the area’s infrastructure and quality of life. We are allocating $100 million for parkland improvements, including new walking paths, playgrounds, and the revitalization of Ferry Point Park, as well as at least $75 million for transportation upgrades such as a new Lafayette Avenue overpass, widened roads, and enhanced public transit access to the Project Site and Ferry Point Park via two new MTA bus stops.
